description: Launch TikTok on the character's phone
goal: Day 3 of the phone; the Instagram account created on day 1 has been warming since

description: Cold start — TikTok is slow on first open
Never a social login: the account must belong to this email only [to verify]

prompt: TikTok asks for the birthday FIRST. Set {birthday} on the wheel (18+) and tap Next, then resume.
description: Birthday, before the email on TikTok (account-creation.md §6.2)
The character's own Gmail, created at J0
Ask for the email code [to verify]

prompt: Read the code for {email} in the Gmail notification (GET /api/phone/notifications/<serial>) and type it on the device (POST /api/phone/type). Do not open Gmail — TikTok would lose the foreground. Then resume.

Type the TikTok password for {handle} on the device. Read it from the Keychain (ofmai-social-tiktok-<slug>) and type it with POST /api/phone/type; it is never a parameter of this run (R9). Tap Next, then resume.

TikTok shows a slider or a 'select 2 objects' puzzle here. Those same strings are health.py's `verification` patterns, but at signup this is a normal gate: solve it by hand (R25). Three failures in a row end the day. Then resume.

description: TikTok assigns a random username; open the field to replace it [to verify]

prompt: If the username is taken, clear it and type fallback handle 2, then 3, from the persona sheet — and update the sheet. Dismiss the interest picker and any follow suggestion without following anyone (R16). Then resume.
Profile picture: open the picture editor and pick the MOST RECENT gallery item — the watermarked SFW variant pushed with adb push minutes ago. Confirm, come back to the editor, then resume.

description: Display name from the persona sheet
TikTok bio of the persona sheet — one line, ASCII, no link (TikTok gates links anyway, and R22 forbids one before day 24)

prompt: Privacy: the account stays public, and 'Suggest your account to others' goes OFF (Settings and privacy > Privacy). Do not touch anything that looks like an AI label: on TikTok the AIGC label is posted per post, from the publication order, never as an account setting (R2, R3). Then resume.

Last look: the profile shows {handle}, the bio and the picture, and no link. Register it on the Mac mini the same day — accounts add tiktok @{handle} --device <serial> --tz <persona tz> --created-on <today> — then resume to close the run.
description: The run ends on the profile screen showing {handle}
